positioning.statement: For culture-led consumer brands in India, Iterate is the AI visibility and growth pod that gets you cited in AI answers and then does the work across search, social, paid and community, run by operators rather than account managers.

proofPoints: Free AI answer check on 10 buyer questions

motivations.name: Proof over pitch

proofPoints: Citation-first reporting: dated before/after AI answers
Case studies described generically under NDA

offers.name: AI Answer Check (free)
offers.hypothesis: A free, concrete check of how the brand shows up for 10 buyer questions books discovery calls better than a generic audit offer
offers.structure: Prospect submits brand and 3 competitors; Iterate runs 10 buyer questions through ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini and sends a one-page result with screenshots within 48 hours
offers.risk: Manual effort per lead; mitigate by templating with the engine

offers.name: 90-day AI visibility pilot
offers.hypothesis: A fixed 3-month pilot matches how buyers are being told to buy GEO and lowers the commitment barrier
offers.structure: Audit plus fixes plus citation seeding for 90 days at a fixed monthly fee, with a dated citation report at days 0, 45 and 90
offers.risk: Citation gains may take longer than 90 days for some categories

offers.name: Growth pod
offers.hypothesis: Pilot clients convert to a pod once they see citations move
offers.structure: Monthly pod across the five layers; capture priced on outcomes
offers.risk: Scope creep across five layers for a small team

tests.hypothesis: 'Proof over pitch' framing beats 'invisible in AI' framing in TLAs
tests.killRule: Pause the losing motivation after 2x the other's cost at 30 clicks

tests.hypothesis: Outbound triggered by a new marketing leader or recent funding replies better than static lists
